name: Japhet Ledesma
text:
We came to this public park with my sister just to take a few pictures, and we planned to stay for no more than 30 minutes. Unfortunately, we were approached by an Egyptian security guard who immediately started shouting at us, it was 3pm. saying we had to leave because we were “not a family.”
I calmly explained that they are my sister and that this is a public park, but he refused to listen and insisted that we leave. His attitude was rude, disrespectful, and completely unprofessional. There was no valid reason for us to be treated this way.

This kind of behavior is absolutely unacceptable, especially in a public place where people should feel welcome and safe. Security staff should know the rules and treat visitors with basic respect, not harass and with proper manners also without proper understanding.

I strongly hope management takes action and properly trains their staff, because experiences like this leave a very bad impression.

name: Tim Griffiths
text:
Very nice spot for a Sunday morning run or just to chill on the beach or boardwalk. There's a small toiket block, changing rooms and showers - toilets are cleaned regularly and we're clean.

There's limited parking, which is free on Holidays and Sundays. There were quite a few people double parked and a guy was out ticketing cars for not being parked properly or in parking bays. We saw one car being ticketed and it wasn't causing an obstruction or blocking anyone's drive and clearly they'd made an effort to parked nearly and tidily yet they still were being issued with a ticket; that's really officious ticketing 🤔.

The adjacent public park.was very clean with well kept gardens, a 560m running track and tidy children's play area.

Along the seafront there's a clearly marked rubberised running track, a cycle track plus walkway and easy access to the beach. There's a cafe in the park plus a small kiosk type cafe serving hot and cold snacks and drinks, ice creams, smoothies, shakes and the odd beach toy for children.

The beach is very clean and even at 8am on a Sunday there were quite a few people around, lots running despite the 27 drgree temperatures and some taking surfboards out to the sea. There's a weekend running club which do a 5k on a Saturday morning and a slightly longer run on a Sunday starting at around 8am.

text: Very good sea facing park with cool breeze during October till march from the beach with lots of swing and slides for kids to play. Good place to plan for a gathering as there are many quiet corners away from all the noise. There is a very good seafood restaurant and their fresh fish grill and fish fries are excellent. After spending quality time at the beach many visitors visit this restaurant and park. Its neat and clean with washrooms available.
